name: AUTOPILOT.OI Sales Agent
description_html:
Turn TikTok attention into honest sales.

Learns your product from your notes, drafts videos that sell without feeling like ads, scripts your LIVEs, and drafts replies to comments and DMs in your voice for you to send.

What you get: a Claude prompt kit (PDF): the master prompt, 5 starter prompts, a 10 minute setup guide and a tracker.

How it works: you paste the prompt into a Claude Project and run it whenever you need it. It reads what you upload and drafts. You check it, decide and send. It does not post, go LIVE or reply to anyone on its own.

You need: a Claude account (the free plan works, up to 5 Projects) and notes on your product and a few examples of how you talk.

Education only. Confirm TikTok's current rules and fees in the app. AUTOPILOT.OI is independent and not affiliated with Anthropic or TikTok.
